rationale: Inside this frozen skeptical review, material-decision differences are not confined to cross-condition comparisons: the within-condition set contains both absent and present frozen judgments, and the cross-condition set likewise contains both. Recurrent move families also cross pair roles without a uniform relationship to the frozen material-difference label. Prospective falsification, evidence mapping, independent-test governance, credibility tracking, claim records, contextual review, separable decisions, reversal rules, identity-blind review, prestige-triggered pauses, and the potentially stricter expansion gate all recur in different pairings, but some recurrences remain frozen absent while others are frozen present. The clearest repeated present pattern—the ambiguous stricter expansion gate together with other arm-exclusive procedures—appears once within condition and once across conditions, while other within-condition present families reappear in an absent cross-condition pairing. Accordingly, the revealed condition labels do not make the cross-condition differences distinguishable from the variation already present within conditions in this one frozen review. This is a qualitative recurrence interpretation only: it does not count observations into a score, estimate an effect, attribute causation to graph access, or make any claim about correctness, relevance, answer quality, value, expected behavior, or human usefulness.
